info.description:
🍔Restaurant Management System API Documentation

Simplified Restaurant Management System API that supports

- menu management.
    
- order management.
    
- user authentication.
    

### Authentication

The API supports authentication using **JWT (JSON Web Tokens)** via the `Authorization` header. Use this method to access protected endpoints.

#### 1\. JWT in Authorization Header

Include a valid JWT token in the `Authorization` header for endpoints that require authentication. This method ensures secure access for both mobile and browser clients.

**Example:**

``` json
Authorization: Bearer <your_token_here>

 ```

---

### Response Format

All responses follow this structure:

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Optional descriptive message",
  "data": { ... }
}

 ```

### Error Handling

Errors are returned in the following format:

``` json
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Error description",
  "data": null
}

 ```

### Get Menu Item Details

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific menu item identified by its `itemID`.

#### Request

- Method: GET
    
- Endpoint: `{{baseUrl}}api/v1/menu/item/:itemID`
    

#### Response

The response will include the following fields:

- `status` (boolean): Indicates the success or failure of the request.
    
- `message` (string): Provides additional information about the request status.
    
- `data` (object): Contains the details of the menu item.
    
    - `item` (object): Represents the menu item with the following attributes:
        
        - `id` (number): The unique identifier of the item.
            
        - `name` (string): The name of the item.
            
        - `description` (string): The description of the item.
            
        - `price` (string): The price of the item.
            
        - `createdAt` (string): The timestamp of item creation.
            
        - `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp of item update.
            
        - `category` (object): Represents the category of the item with the following attributes:
            
            - `id` (number): The unique identifier of the category.
                
            - `name` (string): The name of the category.
                

#### Related Responses

The response from other endpoints of this API with similar data models includes an array of menu items (`items`) along with additional pagination details such as `totalItems`, `totalPages`, and `currentPage`.

Example Response:

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "item": {
      "id": 0,
      "name": "",
      "description": "",
      "price": "",
      "createdAt": "",
      "updatedAt": "",
      "category": {
        "id": 0,
        "name": ""
      }
    }
  }
}

 ```

The API endpoint retrieves a list of menu items based on the provided category and sorting parameters.

### Response

The response will be a JSON object with the following properties:

- `status` (boolean): Indicates the status of the request.
    
- `message` (string): Provides any additional information related to the request.
    
- `data` (object): Contains the data related to the menu items.
    
    - `items` (array): An array of menu items, each containing the following properties:
        
        - `id` (number): The unique identifier of the menu item.
            
        - `name` (string): The name of the menu item.
            
        - `description` (string): A brief description of the menu item.
            
        - `price` (string): The price of the menu item.
            
        - `createdAt` (string): The timestamp indicating the creation date of the menu item.
            
        - `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp indicating the last update date of the menu item.
            
        - `category` (object): Contains information about the category of the menu item.
            
            - `id` (number): The unique identifier of the category.
                
            - `name` (string): The name of the category.
                
- `totalItems` (number): The total number of menu items available.
    
- `totalPages` (number): The total number of pages based on the available menu items.
    
- `currentPage` (number): The current page number of the retrieved menu items.
    

Example Response:

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 0,
        "name": "",
        "description": "",
        "price": "",
        "createdAt": "",
        "updatedAt": "",
        "category": {
          "id": 0,
          "name": ""
        }
      }
    ],
    "totalItems": 0,
    "totalPages": 0,
    "currentPage": 0
  }
}

 ```

This request returns a 200 status code upon successful execution.

# Retrieve Order Details

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific order identified by the provided `orderID`.

## Request

- Method: GET
    
- Endpoint: `{{baseUrl}}api/v1/order/one/:orderID`
    

### Path Parameters

- `orderID` (integer): The unique identifier of the order to retrieve.
    

### Headers

No specific headers are required for this request.

### Response

The response will contain the following fields:

- `status` (boolean): Indicates the success or failure of the request.
    
- `message` (string): A message related to the request.
    
- `data` (object): An object containing the details of the retrieved order.
    

#### Order Object

- `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the order.
    
- `userID` (integer): The user ID associated with the order.
    
- `total` (string): The total amount of the order.
    
- `status` (string): The status of the order.
    
- `number` (integer): The order number.
    
- `createdAt` (string): The date and time of order creation.
    
- `updatedAt` (string): The date and time of the last update to the order.
    
- `orderedBy` (object): An object containing details of the user who placed the order.
    
    - `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the user.
        
    - `username` (string): The username of the user.
        
- `items` (array): An array of items included in the order, each containing the following details:
    
    - `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the item.
        
    - `name` (string): The name of the item.
        
    - `price` (string): The price of the item.
        
    - `order_items` (object): An object containing the price and quantity of the item in the order.
        
        - `price` (string): The price of the item in the order.
            
        - `quantity` (integer): The quantity of the item in the order.
            

In case of an empty `items` array, the response will still contain the order details with an empty array for items.

## Example

### Request

```
GET {{baseUrl}}api/v1/order/one/123

 ```

### Response

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "order": {
      "id": 123,
      "userID": 456,
      "total": "100.00",
      "status": "pending",
      "number": 789,
      "createdAt": "2022-01-01T12:00:00Z",
      "updatedAt": "2022-01-02T10:00:00Z",
      "orderedBy": {
        "id": 456,
        "username": "user123"
      },
      "items": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "name": "Product A",
          "price": "50.00",
          "order_items": {
            "price": "50.00",
            "quantity": 2
          }
        },
        {
          "id": 2,
          "name": "Product B",
          "price": "25.00",
          "order_items": {
            "price": "25.00",
            "quantity": 1
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

 ```

### Delete Order by ID

This endpoint is used to delete a specific order by its ID.

#### Response

The response for this request will be a JSON object with the following properties:

- `status` (boolean): Indicates the success or failure of the request.
    
- `message` (string): Provides additional information about the request status.
    
- `data` (object): Contains the response data which may include the following properties:
    
    - `items` (array): An array of items associated with the order, each containing the following properties:
        
        - `id` (number): The ID of the item.
            
        - `name` (string): The name of the item.
            
        - `description` (string): The description of the item.
            
        - `price` (string): The price of the item.
            
        - `createdAt` (string): The date and time when the item was created.
            
        - `updatedAt` (string): The date and time when the item was last updated.
            
        - `category` (object): An object representing the category of the item, containing the following properties:
            
            - `id` (number): The ID of the category.
                
            - `name` (string): The name of the category.
                
    - `totalItems` (number): The total number of items associated with the order.
        
    - `totalPages` (number): The total number of pages for the items.
        
    - `currentPage` (number): The current page number.
        

#### Example

``` json
{
    "status": true,
    "message": "",
    "data": null
}

 ```

### API Request Description

This endpoint allows users to authenticate and obtain a token for accessing protected resources. The request should be sent via an HTTP POST method to the `{{baseUrl}}api/v1/auth/login` endpoint, with the following payload in the raw request body:

``` json
{
  "email": "string",
  "password": "string"
}

 ```

- `email`: The email address of the user.
    
- `password`: The password associated with the user's account.
    

### API Response

The response for this request will be a JSON object with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "status": "boolean",
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "userID": "integer",
      "username": "string",
      "email": "string",
      "role": "string",
      "createdAt": "string",
      "updatedAt": "string"
    },
    "token": "string"
  }
}

 ```

- `status`: A boolean indicating the success or failure of the request.
    
- `message`: A string containing any additional information or error messages.
    
- `data`: An object containing user information and an authentication token.
    
    - `user`: An object containing user details.
        
        - `userID`: An integer representing the user's ID.
            
        - `username`: A string representing the user's username.
            
        - `email`: A string representing the user's email address.
            
        - `role`: A string representing the user's role or permissions.
            
        - `createdAt`: A string representing the date and time of user creation.
            
        - `updatedAt`: A string representing the date and time of user's last update.
            
    - `token`: A string representing the authentication token.
        

### Related Responses

Calls to other endpoints of this API may return data with similar data models, such as a list of items with their details and categories.

Example Response:

``` json
{
  "status": "boolean",
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "integer",
        "name": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "price": "string",
        "createdAt": "string",
        "updatedAt": "string",
        "category": {
          "id": "integer",
          "name": "string"
        }
      }
    ],
    "totalItems": "integer",
    "totalPages": "integer",
    "currentPage": "integer"
  }
}

 ```

This response is accompanied by a 200 status code, indicating a successful request.
